_doc: CH-timeframe-ssot-v2 re-measure config: identical to research_config_spine_htf_majors.json except spine.prod_version is the ACTIVE composite. The standing config's v2_multi_2026_04 cannot construct a BacktestConfig (no backtest.timeframe since EPIC-84), so the F-027 spine arm was NOT_MEASURABLE for that reason. This measures the CURRENT production spine (ParentCRT etc.), a different object from the legacy composite F-027 recorded; report it as a new measurement.
_horizon_doc: Program 3A = BAR_COUNT_CONSTANT (PRIMARY): harness warmup/window_size/max_forward stay in BARS (max_forward=40 = 10h M15 / 40h H1 / 160h H4). Program 3B (WALL_CLOCK_CONSTANT) is pre-defined but NOT implemented. See research_config_htf_majors.json _horizon_doc.

spine._timeframe_note: CH-timeframe-ssot-v2: the run declares its real timeframe (qualify_htf substitutes {TF}) and a session-gap limit of gap_reset_bars bars (8 = the active 120 minutes at M15, held constant in BARS as Program 3A holds every bar count). The production file declares M15, which FeaturePipeline now refuses on an H1/H4 stream.
